recognize_zh: 組圖中肝臟可見大量髓外造血（成群紅血球前驅細胞及巨核細胞），小腸有黏膜發炎與紫色鈣化灶，而箭頭所指的血管內有核紅血球細胞核變大，含毛玻璃狀嗜酸或雙染性核內包涵體並將染色質推向核膜邊緣，這是微小病毒 B19 的細胞病變效應。
features: Panel a (liver): prominent extramedullary hematopoiesis with clusters of erythroid precursors and a megakaryocyte
Panels b-c (small intestine): mucosal/submucosal inflammation with scattered dark basophilic calcific deposits
Panels c-f (arrows): intravascular nucleated red cells with enlarged nuclei containing glassy amphophilic to eosinophilic intranuclear inclusions and marginated chromatin
Panel f (chorionic villus): fetal capillary containing an erythroid precursor with a dense intranuclear inclusion
Autolytic change consistent with intrauterine fetal demise limits cellular detail
describe_en: Postmortem sections of the fetus show prominent extramedullary hematopoiesis in the liver, composed of clusters of erythroid precursors with scattered megakaryocytes (a). The small intestine shows mucosal and mural inflammation with multifocal dystrophic calcifications (b, c). Intravascular nucleated red blood cells in the intestine, liver, spleen, and chorionic villi (c-f, arrows) have enlarged nuclei with glassy, homogeneous intranuclear inclusions and peripheral chromatin margination. Background autolysis limits assessment of fine cellular detail. Findings are consistent with fetal parvovirus B19 infection; confirmation by parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: CMV causes cytomegaly of endothelial and epithelial cells with owl-eye intranuclear plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions, whereas parvovirus inclusions are restricted to erythroid precursors without cytomegaly.

ddx.dx: Hydrops due to alloimmune hemolytic disease
ddx.vs: Alloimmunization produces marked erythroblastosis without intranuclear viral inclusions and is associated with a positive DAT and maternal antibody.
HSV shows multinucleation, nuclear molding, and chromatin margination in epithelial cells with necrosis, not inclusions confined to erythroid precursors.
Autolysis produces pyknosis or karyolysis without discrete glassy inclusions with a marginated chromatin rim, and IHC for parvovirus is negative.
